title: Stationarity tested on the radial field g(y)·y gives Euler's identity ∫(n·g + Dg(y)y) dμ_C = 0 (identity (H))
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and let C be an n-varifold on ℝ^N (C : Varifold N n univ) which is stationary in ℝ^N (C.firstVariation X = 0 for every C¹ compactly supported vector field X) and satisfies p_S(y) = y for C-a.e. (y,S), where p_S = Grassmannian.project S. Let μ_C = C.weight = π_#C. Then for every C¹ function g : ℝ^N → ℝ with compact support, ∫ (n·g(y) + Dg(y)(y)) dμ_C(y) = 0, where Dg(y) = fderiv ℝ g y.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))), C.Stationary → (∀ᵐ z ∂C.measure, Grassmannian.project z.2 z.1 = z.1) → ∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → ∫ y, ((n : ℝ) * g y + fderiv ℝ g y y) ∂C.weight = 0
